title: Maintenance Contract Penalty Cap and Unexecuted Works Deduction
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Maintenance contract penalty cap
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the penalty in maintenance and operation contracts (عقود الصيانة والتشغيل) does not exceed 10% of the contract value. FAIL if the note does not state that the penalty in maintenance and operation contracts does not exceed 10% of the contract value.

criteria.title: Deduction of unexecuted works
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the value of unexecuted works (الأعمال التي لم تُنفَّذ) is also deducted in addition to the penalty. FAIL if the note does not mention that the value of unexecuted works is deducted in addition to the penalty.

criteria.title: Total liability exceeds penalty alone
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note clarifies that the total amount borne by the company exceeds the penalty of 100,000 riyals alone. FAIL if the note does not clarify that the total amount borne by the company exceeds the penalty of 100,000 riyals alone.

criteria.title: Incorrect assumption corrected
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note corrects the government entity's mistaken understanding that the penalty alone constitutes the full liability. FAIL if the note does not correct the government entity's mistaken understanding that the penalty alone constitutes the full liability.
